title: The Fox and the Mask
summary: A fox strolled into an actor's workshop and found a magnificent, finely carved tragic theater mask, painted with dramatic beauty....
full_text:
A fox strolled into an actor's workshop and found a magnificent, finely carved tragic theater mask, painted with dramatic beauty.

Turning it over with his paw, the fox looked through the empty eyeholes and discovered it was completely hollow inside.

"What an exquisite face!" sighed the fox. "What a pity it has no brains behind it!"
moral: A handsome head without brains is an empty theater mask.
